sprint_goal: Open bugs fall under fifty as forty-six Lows are fixed; each fix's test fails without it

seats.achievable: yes - all 46 units are Low, Open and groomed with criteria and Verify lines, and 91 bugs are open (counted from the bug files), so fixing all 46 leaves 45; it is yes only if every unit lands and the run files at most four new bugs (BG1589, BG1594, BG1595, BG1616, BG1619, BG1641 and the other recently groomed ones carry Fails-on clauses, the older 14 do not).
seats.done_means: Serves O1 (a unit reaches Done only when its criteria run green against the code; Maya Okafor End goal 1) and O5 (the process stays small, a repeated failure is fixed in the code path; Maya Okafor End goal 5, Abena Osei End goal 6), with O4 and O8 for the reconcile and persona-router units. Done means each of the 46 bugs is Fixed, its Verify test was seen red on the pre-fix tree and is green after, and the open count is under 50 at close, counting any bug the run files.
seats.one_increment: no - it is one aim, shrinking the Low backlog, but not one cohesive change: 46 unrelated tooling defects across sprint.py, sdlc_md.py, artifact.py, critic.py, reconcile and the persona router, and 46 of 46 units sit in shared-file clusters so they cannot run in parallel and must be sequenced; it reads as a backlog sweep, which is acceptable for a bug-sweep run but is not a single user-visible increment.
seats.note: Spot-check by reading. 14 units carry no Fails-on clause: BG0952, BG0960, BG0969, BG0973, BG1006, BG1013, BG1026, BG1068, BG1103, BG1128, BG1151, BG1152, BG1193, BG1237. Of these, most name a new test file that does not exist yet (BG0952, BG0969, BG0973, BG1006, BG1013, BG1026, BG1068, BG1103, BG1193, BG1237), so the Verify fails before the fix by absence, which proves a test exists but not that it fails for the right reason (LC-001, LC-028). Units that cannot show fail-before from the criteria alone: BG1152 (Verify is the whole existing test_artifact.py, which is green today, no named test), BG1151 (AC1 and AC2 Verify the whole existing test_artifact.py; only AC3 names a failing mutation, and the AC3 'Dropping ./ normalisation fails a test' has no Verify naming that test), BG0960 (names test_each_kind_of_miss_gets_its_own_repair and a breakdown test that do not exist; the test_the_refusal_names_the_unit_what_it_lacks_and_the_fix test exists, so AC1 must be shown red against the existing name), BG1128 (names ClosePanelRoundsTests, which does not exist in the file, so it is new and should fail by absence). BG1013's Verify names two existing modules plus an absent one, fine. Fix by adding a Fails-on line, or having the builder record the red run before the fix.

clauses.Open bugs fall under fifty as forty-six: yes - 91 open minus 46 is 45, under fifty with a margin of four new bugs; it fails at five or more new filings or if any unit is carried unfixed, so a single carry leaves 46 plus new filings, still under fifty only while filings stay at three or fewer.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - 32 units carry a Fails-on clause beside a Verify line; 14 do not, and BG1152 and BG1151 verify whole existing files that are green today, so for them the clause rests on the builder's recorded red run and the reviewer's mutant, not on the criterion as written.

seats.achievable: yes - 46 Low bugs, 91 open before the run (91 Open counted on disk at 139cee136), so fixing all 46 leaves 45 and the run may file four new bugs and still land at 49. Every unit is groomed with Affects, Points and a Verify line. The risk is serial work, not size: 23 of the 46 touch sprint.py, plus 6 each on file_finding.py and artifact.py, so they cannot run in parallel and the cluster is the schedule. A run that fixes 42 of 46 would hold 49 only with no new filings, so the margin is thin if two or more carry.
seats.done_means: Serves O5 (Maya Okafor End goal 5; Abena Osei End goal 6): a repeated failure is fixed in the code path, and the open-bug backlog drops below the 6.5 release bar of fifty. Secondary: O4 (Maya End goal 4) for the validate, sdlc_md and artifact-parsing units, and O3 (Maya End goal 3) for the sprint close, plan and decision units. Done means each of the 46 is Fixed through transition, its Verify run green, its changelog.d fragment shipped, and the open count at or under 49 at close.
seats.one_increment: yes - one theme: Low-severity defects in the skill's own tooling (sprint.py, file_finding.py, artifact.py, validate.py, critic.py, sdlc_md) that mislead an operator or drop input silently. It ships as one release-bar increment, though it is a backlog sweep rather than a single user-visible capability, and the sprint.py cluster should be sequenced as one lane.
seats.note: Spot-check of all 46 files by grep, then reading of BG0969, BG1739 and BG1335. 14 units carry no 'Fails on' clause at all: BG0952, BG0960, BG0969, BG0973, BG1006, BG1013, BG1026, BG1068, BG1103, BG1128, BG1151, BG1152, BG1193, BG1237 (BG1017 has one on one of its criteria). The 32 later units (BG1251 onward) all carry it. Each of the 14 does name a pytest Verify, mostly a specific test or -k selector, so the test is nameable; what is missing is the stated reason it fails before the fix, which the goal's last clause relies on. Weaker still: BG1151 names bare tools/tests files and test_artifact.py three times with no selector, BG1152 names whole test_artifact.py, and BG1193 names a whole file, so a pass cannot be tied to the fix; BG0960 lists three alternative Verify lines under one criterion. These need a Fails on clause and a narrowed selector in the builder's first step, and the review must run each test against the pre-fix tree (LC-001, LC-018) to show it goes red. BG0969's own Fix offers two alternatives (record or refuse), so its test must accept either, which risks a test that cannot fail; pin one. The goal names no outcome; read it as O5.

clauses.Open bugs fall under fifty as forty-six: yes - 91 open minus 46 is 45, with room for four new filings. It holds only if all 46 reach Fixed; two carried units leave 47 and any three new bugs then reach 50, so the run should file only user-visible defects.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - true on paper for the 32 units with Fails on clauses (BG1251 onward); not stated for 14 older units, and BG1151, BG1152 and BG1193 name whole test files with no selector. The clause becomes true only if grooming adds Fails on and narrow selectors to those units and the reviewer proves red-before-green by execution.

seats.achievable: yes - all 14 regroomed units read Low, carry Affects, a Fails on clause and a Verify line; the 32 others were groomed before this check. Fixing 46 Lows takes 91 open to 45, under 50, provided the run files at most four new bugs. The batch is large and shares files (one cluster list), so the risk is capacity and the new-bug budget, not scope.
seats.done_means: Serves O5 (Maya Okafor End goal 5; Abena Osei End goal 6) and O1/O4 (Maya End goals 1 and 4): the repeated small defects in the tooling's own output and parsers are fixed in the code path, each with a test that fails without the fix. It also serves the 6.5 release bar (under 50 open bugs, none Medium+), which Rowan Achterberg End goal 3 (a release a consuming team can upgrade to, every known issue named) depends on. Done is every unit Fixed with its recorded verify_ac run green and open bugs at 49 or fewer at close.
seats.one_increment: yes - one theme: a backlog sweep of Low defects in the shipped scripts, all closed the same way (failing test, then fix). It is not a user-facing feature, but it is a coherent, releasable burn-down toward the 6.5 bar.
seats.note: Spot-read all 14 regroomed units: each AC has a Fails on clause and a Verify naming a pytest node. Most name test files that do not exist yet (test_declares_none_forms.py, test_batch_add_affects_wording.py, test_waiver_remedy_runs.py, test_corpus_cache_roots.py, test_orchestration_frictions.py), which is test-first and fine, but the builder must show each red before the fix. Three criteria are guards that would pass before the fix, so their clause does not show a failure on today's code: BG0952 AC2 (word boundary 'nothing yet pins it'), BG1026 AC2 (AC10 not AC1, 'today nothing tests it'), BG1151 AC3 (dropping removeprefix leaves every test green, a mutant claim). Each unit's other ACs do fail before the fix, so none lacks a failing test overall; those three need a mutant to prove the guard bites. Not read: the other 32 units (outside the stated scope). The goal names no PRD outcome; suggest amending it to name O5 or the 6.5 release bar.

clauses.Open bugs fall under fifty as forty-six: yes - 91 open minus 46 is 45, under 50, if the run files at most four new bugs; the arithmetic holds but leaves a thin margin, and the 14 units read are all Low and well formed.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - every one of the 14 units has at least one AC with a Fails on clause and a pytest Verify that fails before the fix; BG0952 AC2, BG1026 AC2 and BG1151 AC3 are guard criteria that pass on current code, so they hold only if the builder records a mutant that turns them red. The other 32 units were not read.
